en: Hey there, you two. Something wrong?
No, nothing's wrong...
...Hey, Rantaro.

You said there's someone behind all this,
right? That Monokuma is just a puppet.

I did say that.
But you know what? It's just a hunch.

I sure wouldn't complain if that's
how it all turned out, though.
And away he goes...

Nyeeeh... Hey, you guys...
Save me from this conversation...

What's the matter, Himiko!? We're not
done talking yet, are we!?
Tenko, what are you doing?

I was hoping I could learn more about magic
from Himiko!

I definitely wanna incorporate magic into
Neo-Aikido!

Please tell me, Himiko! What sort of training
do you usually do!?
I told you I get tired talking about it.

Then I'll massage your back so you
won't get tired!

I wouldn't mind if you rested your head
on my lap either.
Stop it. That's weird...

Let me know when you get tired!
I'll carry you, Himiko!
I said that's weird... Leave me alone...
...Kaede, we should go to the library.
...Kaede, we should go to the library.
...Kaede, we should go to the library.
...Kaede, we should go to the library.
...Kaede, we should go to the library.

Um, Kaede? That's the boys bathroom...
Do you have...a reason to be in there?

O-Ooh, sorry!
My mistake!
Ah, you want me to...wait for you?

N-No, it's okay!
Sorry, let's get going!
...Kaede, we should go to the library.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us...
But there's nothing displayed right now.
...Kaede, we should go to the library.
